run_TestCase_test_interoperability: run a gRPC interoperability test case by calling test_interoperability on a TestCase enum member with a stub
test_large_unary_common_behavior: test large unary call behavior with optional username, OAuth scope, and call credentials on a gRPC stub
test_Pipe_threading_primitive: test the Pipe class as a thread-safe producer-consumer queue for streaming gRPC requests and responses
test_custom_metadata: test sending and validating initial and trailing metadata on gRPC unary and full-duplex calls
test_oauth2_auth_token: test OAuth2 authentication by verifying the server-returned username and OAuth scope match expected credentials
